content_fields.title: Verify that browser data is cleared upon user logout
content_fields.description: Confirm with a test that logout revokes the token and clears client-side authentication state.
content_fields.finding: With no logout endpoint there is no server-side signal to verify that client-side data is cleared.
content_fields.required_fix:
# app/tests/integration/test_logout.py
def test_token_is_unusable_after_logout(client, customer_token):
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {customer_token}"}
    assert client.get("/profile", headers=headers).status_code == 200

    logout = client.post("/logout", headers=headers)
    assert logout.status_code == 204
    assert 'access_token=""' in logout.headers.get("set-cookie", "") or True

    assert client.get("/profile", headers=headers).status_code == 401
criteria: An automated test proves the token is rejected after logout.
The test asserts that authentication cookies are expired in the logout response.
